  (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) 
  (n : ℕ) : motive n :=

    n.dite 
      (fun h => zero) 
      (fun hne =>
        let b := Nat.isOdd n
        let k := n / 2
        let pos_n : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
        let hk : k < n := Nat.div_lt_self n 2 Nat.one_lt_two
        bit b k (self k hk)
      )
